commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
90+7' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

90+5' Kevin Danso (Tottenham) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
90+4' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Robert Jones signals. Tottenham get a free kick.
90+3' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Brentford will take a corner kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' This would have been a magnificent goal from Igor Thiago (Brentford), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the right post.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) comes onto the pitch for Dango Ouattara.
85' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.

84' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes behind for a corner. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
83' What a sweet touch by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Caoimhin Kelleher to hold.
81' Here is a change. Cristian Gabriel Romero is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Danso (Tottenham).
80' A substitution has been made. Mohammed Kudus is replaced by Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
79' A goal, which was scored by Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham), was disallowed due to offside.
77' Archie Gray (Tottenham) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Keith Andrews has decided to make a change. Vitaly Janelt replaces Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
76' Substitution. Michael Kayode (Brentford) makes way for Aaron Hickey.
74' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani will be replaced by Wilson Odobert (Tottenham).
72' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

71' Igor Thiago (Brentford) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Guglielmo Vicario easily makes the save.
70' Richarlison (Tottenham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
69' Total attempts – 13:2.
68' Richarlison (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
68' Rico Henry (Brentford) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
67' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joao Palhinha replacing Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
64' Kevin Schade (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
62' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Caoimhin Kelleher.
61' Keith Andrews prepares a substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard is replaced by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).
60' Kevin Schade (Brentford) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
60' What was Kevin Schade (Brentford) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
60' Igor Thiago (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' An attempted cross from Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is cleared.
57' Djed Spence (Tottenham) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
57' Michael Kayode (Brentford) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off the line to clear the ball away.
56' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
55' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
55' Richarlison (Tottenham) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
54' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Caoimhin Kelleher easily deals with the threat.
53' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham).
52' Caoimhin Kelleher (Brentford) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
51' Caoimhin Kelleher (Brentford) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

51' Djed Spence (Tottenham) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Caoimhin Kelleher anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
50' Brentford control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pedro Porro (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Keith Andrews probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Kristoffer Ajer. He is replaced by Rico Henry (Brentford).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robert Jones blows for a foul.
45+1' Kevin Schade (Brentford) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.

43' 2 - 0 Goal! Xavi Simons (Tottenham) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Caoimhin Kelleher had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
40' Randal Kolo Muani (Tottenham) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
40' The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
39' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
39' The ball is cleared after Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
38' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Kevin Schade (Brentford), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, well to the right of the goal.
38' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Brentford will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
36' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
33' 71:29 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
31' It must be a yellow card. It is. Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
30' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Tottenham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Michael Kayode (Brentford) for his blatant foul.
25' 1 - 0 Goal! Xavi Simons passes the ball to the feet of Richarlison (Tottenham), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.
24' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

24' Igor Thiago (Brentford) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Guglielmo Vicario is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
23' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
21' The game is interrupted now, Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Djed Spence (Tottenham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
19' Archie Gray (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
16' Tottenham take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

16' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The linesman points to the corner flag, Tottenham are going to take it.
15' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Caoimhin Kelleher is well positioned and punches the ball away.
14' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Richarlison (Tottenham), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
11' The corner kick from Dango Ouattara (Brentford) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
11' Michael Kayode (Brentford) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Brentford will take a corner.
8' Robert Jones couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Djed Spence (Tottenham) and blew his whistle.
7' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) wins himself enough space to connect with a cross inside the box, but his fine header goes narrowly over the crossbar!
7' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
6' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
5' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Robert Jones will referee today's match.
